traffic-light.label: Traffic light
traffic-light.description: 3 boolean outputs (red, amber, green) + an HMI with coloured indicators. To be programmed.

crossroads.label: Traffic light crossroads
crossroads.description: 12 boolean outputs (red/amber/green × 4 lights: NS1, NS2, EO1, EO2) + an HMI with the crossroads. To be programmed.

drilling.label: Drilling station
drilling.description: Sequential cycle driven by limit switches: start button, lowering, timed drilling, raising. Plant model provided. To be programmed.

elevator.label: Lift
elevator.description: 3-floor lift: landing call buttons and car panel, animated car and door, floor display. Plant model provided. To be programmed.

parking.label: Barrier car park
parking.description: Barrier + space counter: entries/exits via buttons, "full" indicator, gauge and occupancy display. To be programmed.

carton-sorting.label: Carton sorting station
carton-sorting.description: Sorting cartons by height: detection at the post, routing by three cylinders to two output conveyors, counting. Plant model provided. To be programmed.

linear-sequence.label: Linear sequence
linear-sequence.description: A 4-step GRAFCET, a single chain, no timer or divergence. Training module mini-exercise.

and-divergence.label: AND divergence
and-divergence.description: An AND divergence closed by its convergence, two parallel branches. Training module mini-exercise.

or-divergence.label: OR divergence
or-divergence.description: A two-branch OR divergence with mutually exclusive branches, each looping back to the initial state on its own. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-reading.label: Read a Ladder program
ladder-reading.description: Four combinational networks provided: predict the outputs, then check in simulation. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-logic.label: Two-way lighting
ladder-logic.description: Combinational logic: two switches and an enable. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-self-holding.label: Pump: self-holding
ladder-self-holding.description: Push-button start, stop priority, self-holding. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-interlock.label: Reversing motor
ladder-interlock.description: Two interlocked self-holdings with a common stop. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-memory.label: Pump: latched fault
ladder-memory.description: Thermal relay, latched fault lamp, acknowledgement without automatic restart. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-edges-reading.label: Read edges
ladder-edges-reading.description: The same input on a NO, P and N contact: record the timing diagram. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-toggle.label: Toggle switch
ladder-toggle.description: One button turns a lamp on then off: section execution order and P contact. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-gate.label: Motorised gate
ladder-gate.description: Two interlocked directions, limit switches, stop, photocell. The student declares the inputs. Training module synthesis.

ladder-timers-reading.label: Read timers
ladder-timers-reading.description: A TON, a TOF and a TP on the same input: draw the timing diagrams. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-timers.label: Star-delta start
ladder-timers.description: Star then delta with a TON, fan held by a TOF, two-TON blinker. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-counters.label: Counting
ladder-counters.description: Piece counting (CTU), buffer zone (CTUD), stock (CTD). Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-tank.label: Tank
ladder-tank.description: Level hysteresis, alarm, start counter on a P contact. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-scaling.label: Scaling
ladder-scaling.description: Computing a level from a raw value: overflow, truncation, REAL computation. Training module mini-exercise.

ladder-packing.label: Case packing
ladder-packing.description: Conveyor, fault, counting and box change in subprograms. No variables provided. Training module synthesis.

linear-sequence-naive-ladder.label: Linear sequence: textbook method
linear-sequence-naive-ladder.description: Linear GRAFCET implemented with one self-holding per step: observe the overlap. Training module mini-exercise.

linear-sequence-ladder.label: Linear sequence in Ladder
linear-sequence-ladder.description: Implement a linear GRAFCET in Ladder with the three-block method. Training module mini-exercise.

drilling-ladder.label: Drilling station in Ladder
drilling-ladder.description: Drilling GRAFCET in Ladder, timer and descent watchdog. Training module synthesis.

or-divergence-ladder.label: OR divergence in Ladder
or-divergence-ladder.description: An OR divergence implemented in Ladder. Training module mini-exercise.

and-divergence-ladder.label: AND divergence in Ladder
and-divergence-ladder.description: An AND divergence implemented in Ladder. Training module mini-exercise.

traffic-light-ladder.label: Traffic light in Ladder
traffic-light-ladder.description: Traffic light in Ladder with reset and end-of-cycle stop. Training module mini-exercise.

parking-ladder.label: Parking in Ladder
parking-ladder.description: Parking control in Ladder, signalling provided, reset. Training module synthesis.

gate-grafcet-ladder.label: Remote-controlled gate
gate-grafcet-ladder.description: Single-button specification: write the GRAFCET, then implement it in Ladder. Training module synthesis.
